Together with management's 'forward bookings healthy' wording, this points to revenue at or slightly above the $1.59-1.62bn guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2Q26 printed a record revenue of $1.479bn, in line with guidance, and the stock rose +2.29% that session. Monthly traffic days in the baseline move -4.7% to +4.8%.

findings.finding: Citi (as reported 2026-10-12) says Aeromexico is better placed than Volaris to pass high fuel through to fares, citing premium mix, long-haul international and its AICM hub, and expects no material demand damage. It also flags that AICM's move to 48 operations an hour at the end of October could restore slots. Citi calls a Volaris guidance revision 'probable' but makes no such call on Aeromexico.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on this line.

findings.finding: On 2026-08-20 the Eleventh Circuit vacated DOT's September 2025 order ending antitrust immunity for the Delta-Aeromexico JV, so coordinated pricing, scheduling and revenue sharing stay in place. This removes a 2026 overhang that the guide may not have assumed away.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on an earnings day. The ruling came out between prints.

findings.finding: Domestic competition is mixed. Volaris grew 3Q ASMs +11.1% (domestic +11.0%) against Aeromexico domestic ASMs of -3.4% in September. But Volaris cut September capacity 22% from its summer peak, and Citi expects Volaris to revise its guidance. Pressure on domestic yield and capacity relief roughly offset.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None.

outside_window.finding: ASPA strike extension of up to 45 days from 2026-10-01 expires around mid-November. A strike or a costly settlement would resolve then, not inside this window.

findings.finding: Management said on the Q2 call (2026-07-21) that its guidance 'embedded current mortgage rates', about 6.6% on the 30-year. Since then the Fed has raised rates 25bp, the 10-year is above 5%, Freddie Mac PMMS reads 7.40% (week of 2026-10-15) and MBA applications have fallen six weeks in a row to a 20-month low (week ending 2026-10-09). So the implied Q4 (EPS about $2.08-2.38) and the FY guide ($8.39-8.69) rest on a rate roughly 80bp too low. Meanwhile the FY consensus has fallen only 0.6% in the last month. A Q4 guide below the Street, or an FY cut toward the low end, is the likely release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-07-21 Q2 beat on EPS but the Q3 guide was below consensus, and the stock fell -3.93% on the window (-7 to -8.5% pre-market). 2025-07-22: -8.18%. 2025-02-06: -8.42%. All three were mortgage/macro guide disappointments. 2025-04-22: +13.84% when the guide held.

findings.finding: Q3 mortgage volume ran below the guide's assumption that originations would be down at 'the very low end of low single digits'. PennyMac's preliminary July-August funding was $16.6B against $34.9B for all of Q2, about -28% per month. Argus expects Q3 originations at least 5% below Q2. BTIG expects nonbank Q3 volume -3% against a +1% consensus. MBA refinance applications fell 9% in the week ending 2026-09-25, and Q3 2025 had a September refinance surge (refi index +42% YoY). On the other side, Equifax beat EPS in Q1 (+9.7%) and Q2 with the AI cost programme, so I net this to a small miss risk on Q3 revenue and an in-line EPS.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The reported quarter itself has not driven this name. EPS beats in Q1 2026 (+9.7%) and Q2 2026 were followed by -3.04% and -3.93%, both on the guide.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-03/04 FHFA ordered Fannie and Freddie to approve all lenders for VantageScore 4.0, effective immediately. On 2026-09-29 VantageScore went onto the same GSE pricing grid as FICO Classic (FICO fell 27% that day). Equifax sells VS4 at $1 and earns no margin on the FICO scores it passes through, which are about 7% of revenue. Management put full conversion at '$40-50 million of incremental margin' (about 2% of EBITDA), and its July guide assumed 'limited VantageScore revenue'. The call is the first chance to quantify adoption and a 2027 margin tailwind, even as reported revenue falls from lost FICO pass-through.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print has turned on VantageScore. The October 2025 FICO direct-license news hit bureau stocks 8-12% in a day, so this mortgage-score line moves the stock.

findings.finding: Bloomberg reported on 2026-10-01 that FHFA plans to require only two of the three bureaus' reports (bi-merge) 'within weeks', possibly announced at MBA Annual on 10-12. EFX fell 5.9% after hours on that report. Pulte then cancelled his appearance and nothing has been announced. On the Q2 call management said '3B is here to stay', a stance it now has to defend or revise, and any share or price risk it quantifies lands on the 2027 mortgage line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Bi-merge headlines: -5.9% after hours on 2026-10-01, and -5.9% after hours on 2026-09-03 (Pulte's post). Those were headline days, not prints.

findings.finding: EFX goes into the print 15.5% above its 2026-09-30 close of $137.24 (directors' phantom-unit Form 4s). Much of that came on 2026-10-15, +7.25% to $161.26 in a bureau-wide move (TRU +10.7%, FICO +7.0%) for which no announcement was found. The rebound raises the bar the guide has to clear.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2026-07-21 guide-driven drop the stock rebounded +6.3% within a week (7-28). This name round-trips sentiment quickly.

findings.finding: Workforce Solutions' government vertical: the OBBBA Medicaid/SNAP work requirements start in 2027 and will require states to verify more often. About half of states use The Work Number, and management guided government 'growth in 2H'. The Q3 call is a natural place for an early 2027 framework that leans on it. A Senate Democratic investigation into Equifax's pricing (February 2026) is the counterweight.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print has turned on the government line alone.

findings.finding: Hiring, which drives the talent-solutions half of Workforce Solutions' non-mortgage business, stayed flat. August JOLTS hires were 5.2M (rate 3.3%) and openings fell to 7.08M, a five-month low (BLS, 2026-09-29). September CPI came in hot at 3.7% (2026-10-14), so a further Fed hike is in play. Non-mortgage verticals are unlikely to offset mortgage in Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Deutsche Bank cut its target after an earlier guide shortfall on lower mortgage and hiring volumes (undated).

outside_window.finding: A formal FHFA bi-merge directive. Bloomberg says it takes effect 1-3 months after announcement, and no announcement has come. If it lands after 2026-10-21 it is a separate event.
OBBBA Medicaid/SNAP work-requirement verification volumes begin in 2027.

Rule 5 ('no cause' is not evidence): the run-up/positioning finding partly rested on the 10-15 rally having no explanation, so I cut it from -0.8 to -0.4.
Rule 5 (macro transmission): the hiring/CPI macro finding went from -0.3 to -0.2.

Rules 1 and 7: the guidance finding stays at -2.5 because this name has repeatedly sold on weak guides and the company itself tied the guide to the 6.6% rate. p_up moved from 40 to 42 for the mildly call-rich skew and the proxy weighting. abs_move stays at 7.0.
